subject.title: Feature: Add maxTurns/maxToolCalls config option to limit agent iterations

question: Should OpenClaw accept the opt-in global/per-agent hard iteration budget contract proposed by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97485, and if so with which config names, budget unit, unsupported-harness behavior, and exhaustion result?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but adding strict config and agent-loop semantics creates a public runtime and harness contract that automation should not finalize without maintainer product intent.

options.title: Approve or narrow the active PR
options.body: Settle the config names, default-off behavior, budget unit, unsupported-harness behavior, and exhaustion result on the active PR, then merge or request a focused revision.

options.title: Redesign the budget contract
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers design a different single budget model that covers turns, tool calls, and timeout-after-first-tool semantics.

options.title: Decline a core budget surface
options.body: Close this and associated budget requests only if maintainers decide model choice plus existing loop detection are the supported direction.

recommendation.title: Approve or narrow the active PR
recommendation.body: Settle the config names, default-off behavior, budget unit, unsupported-harness behavior, and exhaustion result on the active PR, then merge or request a focused revision.
